verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs say it lets users set up and manage stock option plans, grants, vesting, and exercises, and design employee stock plans, so vesting management is a first-party capability. The evidence is limited to one-line marketing claims, and nothing describes custom schedule configuration or automatic tracking. Missing for 10: documented custom vesting schedule builder, cliff support, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
